name: University of Nova Gorica
summary: Research-focused university on the Italian border with six schools; its Physics and Astrophysics bachelor's is taught in Slovene and English.

handoff.label: Bachelor's study programmes: how to apply

ib.text: The IB Diploma counts as a Slovenian general matura with no recognition step, and the IB result stands in for school years 3–4 in the ranking. B2 English is the minimum for the English courses.

apply.via: eVŠ national portal (joint call for enrolment)

programmes.name: Physics and Astrophysics
programmes.about: Research-oriented physics degree (180 ECTS) taught in Ajdovščina: core mathematics and physics with lab methods in year one, then astrophysics and solid-state physics, with work in the university's research labs.
programmes.ib: Courses run in Slovene and English; B2 English is the minimum. No subject beyond the Diploma is asked of a general-matura holder.
programmes.selectionNote: If applicants exceed places, ranked on secondary-school grades; the IB result stands in for them. 2026/27 rules; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Only Physics and Astrophysics is taught in English; the other six bachelor's (Environment, Viticulture and Enology, Cultural History and others) say their courses are in Slovene.
Full-time study is free for EU citizens in these concession programmes; part-time study costs €3,000 a year for everyone.
The programme page shows only last-round places (10 for EU citizens); ask the student office how many first-round places the English courses have.
